title: Reserve Relief for Paloma Business Owners with a Personal Sender Account
content:
On a withdrawal from a Paloma Business balance, a reserve relief, a percentage off the standing reserve, is decided by the owner's Personal Sender Account, the owner's personal account with Paloma Remit, read from its verification level and its status.

### Relief clause

An account active at Paloma Enhanced, Paloma Premier or Paloma Private Client earns a reserve relief of 50 percent; an account active at Paloma Verified Plus earns 25 percent; every other owner earns none.

The standing reserve is reduced by the reserve relief before it is rounded up to the cent.

### By level of the owner's Personal Sender Account

| Level | Active | Not active |
|---|---|---|
| Paloma Private Client | 50 percent | None |
| Paloma Premier | 50 percent | None |
| Paloma Enhanced | 50 percent | None |
| Paloma Verified Plus | 25 percent | None |
| Paloma Verified | None | None |
| Paloma Starter | None | None |
| No Personal Sender Account | None | None |

### Questions answered

**A standing reserve of 854.321 USD before rounding, for an owner active at Paloma Premier?** Reduced by 50 percent to 427.1605, rounded up to 427.17 USD.

**The same owner's Personal Sender Account is suspended?** Not active: no relief.
